(2) A medical procedure is shown in a close-up; a white laser handset is being applied to a patient's eyelid, leaving tiny white cauterized dots on the skin. Yellow text captions appear at the top and center of the frame. (5) A final white graphic card appears with black and gold text detailing clinic addresses and social media handles.
